// A spatial SDF discretized on a regular lattice spanning Bounds. Values holds
// one signed distance per lattice node, in column/row/layer order; evaluation
// between nodes interpolates trilinearly. Implements the bounded SDF interface:
// Bounds are the lattice domain (finite support).
type SampledSdf3D
    implements IValue, IBoundedSignedDistanceField3D, IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField3D
{
    Values: Array3D<Number>;
    Bounds: Bounds3D;
}
